In repo C:\Users\mariu\ventures\subrogation-recovery, create faithful Norwegian bokmål translations as sibling files named <name>.no.md for these Markdown files: business/business-plan.md (includes a new "Use of funds" pointer line at the end - translate it too), technical/overview.md. Read each with the Read tool and write the sibling with the Write tool. Do NOT modify English originals, do not git commit, do not touch src/. Rules: translate prose, headings, table text and list items fully and faithfully; do NOT translate code, code blocks, file/dir paths, identifiers, brand/company/person names, URLs, email addresses, numbers/figures/dates, A/B/C evidence grades, formulas, or relative link targets (link text may be translated; keep link targets as is; keep references like `financial/model.md` in backticks unchanged). Preserve Markdown structure exactly (heading levels, tables, bullets). Use natural bokmål. The very first line of each output file must be this banner, followed by a blank line, then the translation:
> **Uoffisiell oversettelse (bokmål).** Bekvemmelighetsoversettelse, ikke juridisk/finansiell fagoversettelse. Ved avvik gjelder den engelske originalen. Juridisk og skattemessig innhold er utkast og må gjennomgås av advokat/rådgiver før bruk.
Do not use ruflo/ruvnet tooling. Final report: one line listing files written.
